title: QUBRIC: Co-Designing Queries and Rubrics for RL Beyond Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2606.03968v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Rubric-based RL is a promising route for extending reinforcement learning beyond verifiable rewards, yet existing methods optimize rubrics while treating the query distribution as fixed. We identify a structural bottleneck: rubric quality is constrained by query structure. Open-ended queries yield vague rubrics; naively narrowing them introduces fabricated references that no model can verify, so all responses fail and training receives no reward signal. We present QUBRIC, a framework that co-designs queries and rubrics. Teacher-derived key points ground the rewriting of open-ended queries into scenario-based, evaluable questions. Contrastive rubric generation then turns teacher-policy gaps into query-level criteria, and learnability filtering retains only informative query-rubric pairs for GRPO training. QUBRIC achieves a +5.5 point gain on ArenaHard over the SFT baseline. Trained only on instruction-following data, it further

translated_title: QUBRIC：面向超越可验证奖励的强化学习，协同设计查询与评分标准
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的强化学习是将强化学习扩展到可验证奖励之外的一条有前景的路线，然而现有方法在优化评分标准时将查询分布视为固定不变。我们发现了一个结构性瓶颈：评分标准的质量受查询结构的制约。开放式查询会产生模糊的评分标准；而简单地收窄查询范围则会引入任何模型都无法验证的虚构参考答案，导致所有响应都失败，训练无法获得奖励信号。我们提出了QUBRIC，一个协同设计查询与评分标准的框架。由教师模型提取的关键要点为将开放式查询改写为基于场景、可评估的问题提供了依据；随后，对比式评分标准生成将教师模型与策略模型之间的差距转化为查询层面的评判标准；可学习性过滤则只保留信息丰富的查询-评分标准对用于GRPO训练。QUBRIC在ArenaHard上相比SFT基线取得了+5.5点的提升。仅使用指令遵循数据进行训练，它进一步……
tldr: QUBRIC通过协同设计查询与评分标准——利用教师关键要点将开放式查询改写为可评估的场景化问题、以对比方式将师生差距转化为评分标准、并过滤出可学习的样本用于GRPO训练——突破了查询结构制约评分标准质量这一瓶颈，在ArenaHard上相比SFT基线提升5.5分。
en_tdlr: QUBRIC co-designs queries and rubrics—rewriting open-ended queries into evaluable scenario-based questions using teacher key points, contrastively converting teacher-policy gaps into rubric criteria, and filtering for learnable query-rubric pairs—to overcome the structural bottleneck where query structure constrains rubric quality, achieving a +5.5 point gain on ArenaHard over the SFT baseline.
